pdf_page_count takes the password of an encrypted PDF

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
pdf_bytes = File.read("pdf/password_protected.pdf").bytes
result = Xberg.pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes, '')
puts result.inspect
```
